chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:**
This portion of good and wisdom that proceeds from [GAP-1: REVIEW these three] receptive forms that encompass the whole of spiritual creation [GAP-2] — the good of life ascends [GAP-3] toward its Divine origin.

**¶2:**
[GAP-4] but should the [GAP-5] rise upward [GAP-6] — the wisdom of truths proceeding from the Divine that [GAP-7] — which are received into the interiors, which illuminate and pass inward through the great openings of reception, through every entrance of admission, degree by degree through the successive planes of the mind.

**¶3:**
For four modes of reception open in each degree of spiritual life, ordered according to the four fundamental orientations of the will and understanding, opening downward toward the containing forms below. Therefore the [GAP-8: REVIEW wisdom of] truths proceeding from the Divine shall enter through these openings of reception and illuminate [GAP-9: REVIEW that] state, and draw upward through them whatever is good and whatever interior supporting connection [to higher degrees] exists there.

**¶4:**
From that state [GAP-10: REVIEW the good and truth] shall be distributed [GAP-11: REVIEW throughout the] successive planes of the mind. It shall also be purified within these planes [GAP-12] — one part is refined and it is [GAP-13: REVIEW entirely] elevated into conjunction with those who dwell in states of genuine spiritual life. However, its other part — [GAP-14] what is impure and falsified — shall [GAP-15: REVIEW be cast] downward into separation and rejection.

---
*Note on ¶3:* The "four gates at the four points of the compass" correspond to the four cardinal faculties through which Divine influx is received at every discrete degree — love, wisdom, use, and their containing form — opening "downward" because influx always descends from interiors into exterior vessels. The "little pillar" resists full translation but reads best as the slender interior bond connecting a lower degree to a higher one — the living channel through which good ascends between planes.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: this bit of life and light that comes from [these three] vessels that surround the universe [and the] life comes up [to the light]

[ ... ] b[u]t should the [life] ascend [through the] light of the rays that [come down] which are received, which shine and go in through these great open gates, through these doors, firmament by firmament.

For four [gates o]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar (?) that ex]ists there.

From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [until] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [of darkness] shall all [be cast] down.

fills.explanation: The "three vessels that surround the universe" are the Sun, Moon, and Stars in Manichaean cosmology — corresponding to the three discrete degrees of reception encompassing spiritual creation — and "these three" correctly identifies them as a known triad.
A connective phrase transitioning from the description of the three vessels to the statement about life ascending, linking the source (vessels) to the upward movement of life.
The spiritual reading says life ascends "toward its Divine origin," which in Manichaean cosmological vocabulary is "the light" — the primal Divine source toward which all purified life returns.

The ascending subject must be "life" (the captive living soul/good) rather than "light," since "light of the rays" immediately follows and describes the means of ascent — avoiding redundancy and matching the Manichaean pattern of life ascending through the vehicle of light.

Life ascends "through the" light of the rays — the rays serve as the medium/vehicle through which the living soul rises, consistent with Manichaean cosmology where the Column of Glory (light-rays) is the channel of ascent.

The spiritual reading describes "truths proceeding from the Divine" — in the Kephalaia's natural register, the rays descend ("come down") from the luminaries before being received; influx always descends from interiors into exteriors.

Confirmed: "light" is the natural-plane correspondent of "wisdom" in the spiritual reading; "the light of the rays" = "the wisdom of truths proceeding from the Divine," which is standard Kephalaia vocabulary for Divine illumination entering through gates.
Confirmed: the demonstrative "that" correctly identifies the specific place/state being illuminated — the particular degree of spiritual life into which the light of the rays shines.

Confirmed: the pronoun "it" adequately refers back to the light and life previously described, which is then poured out and distributed to the firmaments; the spiritual reading's expansion ("the good and truth") is the spiritual sense of this single pronoun.

Confirmed: "poured out to the firmaments" describes the initial distribution of the purified substance toward the successive planes, with the subsequent sentence handling the clarification "in" those firmaments.

The clarification process continues progressively through the firmaments "until" a part is cleansed — capturing the temporal/progressive purification across successive degrees before the separation into ascending and descending portions.

Confirmed: "all" captures "entirely" from the spiritual reading — the cleansed part is entirely/wholly taken up into conjunction with the living ones, expressing the completeness of the elevation of the purified portion.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "what is impure and falsified"; in Manichaean cosmological vocabulary, the impure portion that is cast down is consistently described as belonging to "darkness" — the fundamental binary opposite of light in the Kephalaia's register.
Confirmed: "be cast down" is the standard expression for the rejection and separation of impure elements — corresponding to the spiritual reading's "be cast downward into separation and rejection."
